_comment: Empirically derived from this build, not aspirational. IPC p99 threshold is 2x the measured Release p99 (1307 us -> 2600 us); profile-apply p95 is 1800 us, covering the worst observed local run (1040 us) with headroom for CI runners; the line-coverage floor is measured 66.2% minus 6 points. Re-derive after any intentional performance or coverage change.
